name: Hanguid
source:
Not much is known about his background yet but the dwarf showed you only warm friendliness. A brimming pint of ale and a plate of well-roasted boar meat are all this hearty cook needs to be content.

You're unsure how he came to serve the Keeper, but his helpfulness towards you makes him indispensable.

[In game description]
